Gañjaphākhelanakrama
on card-playing. by Vīreśvara, a physician, son of Dattajī an. (put into verse) by Ananta, son of Dattātreya; composed a. Ahmednagar, on orders of Sajawar, master of Ananta. Bikaner 3843. [Page235-a.

Gañjīphākhelana
on card playing. in 31 verses. by Giridhara, son of Śaṅkara an. grandson of Śiva.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. XIII. p.. 81-84. 1903.
